q: Which emission factors should an Indian company use for its carbon inventory?
title: Emission factors for an Indian inventory
short: Use the most specific official source for each activity: CEA for grid electricity, supplier data or IPCC 2006 defaults for fuels, and your suppliers' own figures for purchased goods where they have them. Fill gaps with published sets such as the UK government's, labelled as defaults, and keep one list of sources.
audience: Indian companies building a first inventory

ul: Grid electricity: CEA CO2 baseline database, version for the year.
Fuels: supplier calorific value and carbon content, else IPCC 2006 defaults.
Purchased goods: supplier data, else spend or average factors, labelled.

p: A one-page factor register, with value, unit, source and year, is the first thing a verifier asks for.

senseible: Senseible keeps every figure linked to its source invoice or bill with a fingerprint, so a verifier can trace a total back to the documents it came from.
